title: We Hit 500 Subscribers today! How should we celebrate?

top_liked.author: @MultiShell12
top_liked.text: I recently saw your interview on another channel, and subscribed.  Thank you so much for your work!  Looking forward to reviewing your content!  Deconstructing has been been a journey, but I simply cannot "un-see" all of the messiness of Christianity that I ignored for so many…

top_liked.author: @randellmathews5961
top_liked.text:
I subscribed today!!!
I’m celebrating now by watching all your videos, 
sorry gotta go ❤️

top_liked.author: @kenbattor6350
top_liked.text: Congratulations.  I like to help out Atheist channels when I can.

top_liked.text: Congrats my brother! So happy for you! I make it a habit to celebrate various things all the time with great food and drinks.🎉
